description: For questions about one peptide: published dose ranges and protocols, reconstitution, vial sizes, side effects, storage, half-life, FDA status, stacks and community reports. Each dose row carries an origin label (clinical study, guide, community-reported, regulatory), sources and page links.

peptide.description: Peptide name, alias or slug, e.g. "BPC-157", "reta", "semaglutide", "CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin".

sections.description: Sections to return. Omit for overview and dosing. Add others as needed, e.g. ["side_effects","community"] or ["storage","reconstitution"].
